notes:
READ THIS FIRST - this update will not install over your current app.

Mavin Ops is now signed with a proper release key instead of a development one. Android will not replace an app with a build signed by a different key, so this will fail with "App not installed" until you remove the old one.

1. SIGN IN FIRST, in the app you have now. Uninstalling clears anything held only on the phone, and signing in puts it in your account where the new install picks it up again.
2. Uninstall Mavin Ops.
3. Install this one.

One time only. Every update after this installs normally.

THE OP BOARD OPENS ON AN OVERVIEW. A mining or salvage board was four tabs and no summary, so knowing how the night was going meant reading four screens and holding the answer in your head. There is a fifth now, and the board opens on it: who is on and what they are doing, what has been scouted, what is cooking, and what the night is worth - each a few lines that open the tab that owns them. A pickup call outranks a head count, because a call is the only thing on that board that is somebody waiting on another player. Banked and estimated money are still never added together, and it honours Streamer Mode the way the Split tab does. It owns nothing and changes nothing: every figure is read from the list the tab beside it renders.

FIXED. Choosing a handle now tells you why one was refused instead of "Handle refused" for all six possible reasons.

DATA. No Star Citizen data changed in this build.
